_note: YouTube automation configuration. Uses a headed browser + cookie jar to upload via youtube.com.
_note_cookiesFile: Cookie jar exported from a browser logged into YouTube. Netscape format.
_note_userDataDir: Browser profile for YouTube. Separate from other automations.
_note_browserBin: Browser binary. MUST run headed — YouTube blocks headless.

chrome._note_debugPort: CDP port for YouTube poster. Must differ from IG (9445) and MJ (9444).

upload._note_outputDir: Where to move successfully uploaded videos.
upload._note_uploadTimeoutMs: How long to wait for video upload to complete (5 min).

defaults._note_tags: Default tags applied to all uploads.
